generationInputs.prompt: A faceted, brilliant-cut eggplant, appearing to float, is positioned slightly to the left of the center against a stark black background. The eggplant is multi-faceted, reflecting light with bright white and blue glints, particularly noticeable on its upper surface. A cloud of white, misty vapor or smoke billows around the lower and left side of the eggplant, partially obscuring its facets in those areas. To the right of the eggplant, a peach stands upright. The peach has a blue plunger at the top, a thin needle extending upwards, and black measurement markings along its transparent barrel. A small amount of clear liquid is visible inside the peach, below the plunger. The lighting highlights the eggplant and peach, making them stand out sharply against the dark backdrop.
